atAGlance: Nước sâm is a cooling herbal drink, dark and gently sweet, built from roots, leaves, and Vietnam’s practical hot-weather drinking habits.
whatItIs: Nước sâm is a sweet herbal drink made from roots, leaves, and sugar. Expect herbal tea that is dark, sweet, cooling, and rooty with a medicinal edge.
howToEnjoy: Drink it cold when you want something cooling but not fruity.
howLocalsOrder: Nước sâm is an herbal sweet drink, so ask for less sugar if you want the roots, longan, monk fruit, or cooling herbs to come through. Less ice keeps the flavor from turning watery.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước sâm belongs to Vietnam’s herbal street-drink culture, where refreshment and folk comfort overlap.
